recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist composition featuring a 1940s-era sedan levitating above a tranquil mountain lake landscape. The image uses a collage aesthetic where the car appears as a distinct cutout with a soft drop shadow, set against a painterly, atmospheric background of pine forests and misty mountains under a hazy sky.
coreVisualRelationships: The levitating car acts as the central surrealist disruption of a naturalistic landscape.
The golden, beveled typography sits in the upper third, contrasting with the cool blues and greens of the scenery.
The car's shadow on the clouds creates a sense of physical presence despite the impossible physics.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The car is centered horizontally and vertically, scaled to dominate the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, reflective surface of the lake in the lower left provides a heavy base for the floating elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top display text down to the floating car, then follow the car's forward-leaning angle toward the right-hand forest.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample hazy sky in the upper half allows the floating car and title text to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and greens in the landscape and car body.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm gold and yellow tones in the beveled typography and car chrome.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft white and grey in the misty clouds and lake reflections.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a mid-tone value range, typical of aged color photography from the mid-20th century.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma digital colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and high-contrast serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses a 3D beveled effect with golden metallic gradients
Secondary text is a clean, widely spaced Roman serif
Text blocks are contained within rectangular frames or stepped arrangements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are tightly packed with overlapping bevels to create a solid 'badge' feel.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, decorative 3D title paired with a light, airy, widely-spaced header serif.
graphicDevices: Soft drop shadows on collage elements

preserve: Wide tracking on the top line
Beveled gold effect on the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy slab-serif base for the beveled title.
Matches the traditional Roman serif style of the top header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style landscape painting of a mountain lake surrounded by pine trees under a hazy, overcast sky. In the center of the sky, place a levitating 1940s blue sedan with a soft drop shadow cast onto the clouds below it. The image should have a slight film grain and muted, vintage color grading.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a top header in a widely spaced Roman serif. Below that, add a three-tiered stepped title in a heavy, gold-beveled slab serif font, with each word in its own rectangular frame.

verificationChecks: Is the car floating without visible support?
Does the car have a soft shadow on the clouds?
Is the top text widely spaced?
Is the main title beveled and metallic?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold bevel on the text
mustRedesign: Exact band name and album title wording

mustAchieve: Consistent lighting between the car and landscape

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the car looks like a separate photographic element placed into the scene.
Check that the gold text has a distinct 3D depth.
Verify the landscape feels painterly rather than purely photographic.
Confirm the color palette remains in the muted, vintage range.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surrealist Collage] + [1940s Automobile] + [Mountain Lake Landscape] + [Gold Beveled Slab Serif Typography] with a [1970s Film Grain] finish.
